title: Headless CLI Coding Agent for Automated CI/CD PR Checks
oneLiner: Continue runs both in IDEs and as a headless CLI agent (`cn`) inside CI pipelines to enforce custom engineering rules, audit pull requests, and propose inline fixes.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Continue runs both in IDEs and as a headless CLI agent (`cn`) inside CI pipelines to enforce custom engineering rules, audit pull requests, and propose inline fixes.
steps: Run `cn -p` in GitHub Actions on pull requests
configSnippet: "cn -p 'Check this diff for missing database indexes or unvalidated user inputs and output a markdown checklist.'"
limitations: Requires thoughtful rule scoping in CI to avoid noisy comments on large refactoring PRs.
